analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read in `Type_MLU_Write` due to trusting `cmsMLU->UsedEntries` without validating it against the actual allocated `Entries[]` capacity. The writer loops `for (i=0; i<mlu->UsedEntries; i++)` and reads `mlu->Entries[i]` fields; with a malformed/tainted `cmsMLU` object this reads past the end of the entries array (ASan shows read 4 bytes past a 40-byte allocation). Crash happens in write path, but root cause is missing structural consistency check before iterating serialized MLU entries.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In `cms_profile_fuzzer`, attacker-controlled ICC is opened, `cmsReadTag(hProfile, cmsSigGamutTag)` loads tag data, then `cmsSaveProfileToFile` reserializes all tags via `SaveTags` -> type handler write. The PoC causes a tag object interpreted as MLU during save to have inconsistent internal state (`UsedEntries` larger than allocated entries), so `Type_MLU_Write` over-iterates and performs OOB reads. Trigger requires a crafted profile that survives parsing enough to reach save, and taints MLU metadata used during serialization.
